name: Shirakusa Ibuki
source: Ibuki is the more submissive and introverted out of the Shirakusa twins. She sometimes has trouble properly communicating her thoughts clearly, despite being a thoughtful and studious girl. Her favorite pastimes are reading and self-contemplation.
